notes: The recon system as data (NP_02 s3). A ledger of Pattern Intel (PI 0-3) per House dialect and per named boss rides with the sim: the dialect of an opponent is his House (house_key of the pattern META), his own id when he has no House, or the dialect a bout card names. The dialect track is earned by the sizes - each source has its own rungs, exactly as the table reads (3 scraps or 1 spar -> PI 1; 6 scraps, 3 spars or 1 dual segment -> PI 2); the boss track is PI 3, a named boss beaten once (a dual segment won against him). The effective PI against an opponent is the higher of the two. PI never widens a read: PI 2's +10% is on the tell (the interrupt window) and nothing else; the counter windows stay skill-gated.

counts.scrap: a scrap WON against the dialect (objective met, his KO, or EP at the cap) counts one
counts.spar: a spar fought to its end against the dialect counts one, whatever the result (the lab is the lesson)
counts.segment: a dual segment fought to its end against the dialect counts one, win or lose
counts.beaten: a dual segment won against a named boss (EP majority or his KO) marks him beaten: PI 3 for him

1.label: the colour commentator calls the dialect's habit before the segment

2.label: his tell cue is emphasized; the interrupt window is 10% longer against that dialect

3.label: his pattern page in the Scout Book: tells, strings, phases, the corner's tell

habits.kowalchuk: Watch the shoulder - the Kowalchuks load up from the hips, and the corner shouts it
habits.okafor: Watch the feet - the Okafors set a tempo step before the string; when it doubles, it's the special
habits.moreau: Watch the breath - the Moreaus exhale frost before they throw; the long breath is the big one
habits.tremblay: Watch the glove - a Tremblay turns it a hair before the shot, and steps back to load
habits.macisaac: Watch the shoulder roll - the MacIsaacs haul the net before they swing
habits.tagaq: Listen for the exhale - a Tagaq breathes out soft before he leads, and says sorry before the second
habits.osei: Watch the wraps - the Oseis flash a glint before the hands come
habits.petrov: Listen - the Petrov line taps the chalk and turns the glove; the silence before the shot is the tell
habits.reyes: Watch the hips - the Reyes line sinks before it throws; the deep sink is the special
habits.nguyen-roy: Watch the lead foot - Tam loads it before the shot; the shoulder load is a fake
habits.iron: Watch the load - the Iron extract winds the whole frame; the short wind is the real one
habits.sealed: Listen for the breath - the Commissioner stops breathing before he throws
habits.alfie_crane: Watch the shoulder lean and the reach - Alfie leans before he closes
habits.cassidy_vane: Listen to her corner - every string of hers has its call before it comes
habits.deshawn_vaughn: Watch the gum - he stops chewing before he throws
habits.ioan_vasile: Watch the breath and the hips - Vasile breathes before the form and sets the hip before the guard
habits.sora_kannagi: Watch the step set and the pivot - Sora loads on the pivot
habits.hc0_surety: Watch the weight settle - Surety sits into the shot
habits.hc4_cartographer: Watch the chin tuck and the heel - two tucks, then the heel lifts
habits.hc9_choir: Watch the shoulder and the breath - the Choir stops dead before the armored one
habits.school: Watch the stride - the school kids step in with a shing before they swing

habit_fallback: Watch the {motif} - {dialect} shows it before every string
